x: The end was now in sight, but with Alf Cotton coming through the field and bringing with him his clubmate Bob Goodall, Woodford were now coming to challenge us.
After the 10 laps we moved out on to the road with George leading from Bryan Hawkins and myself, Bob Goodall, McFarlane, and Don Thompson with the French team.
Albert Johnson who was with our Eric Hall at the halfway mark, walked a surprisingly fast second half to finish in front of Bob Goodall of Woodford.
